fields.name: Mud Pot
fields.description:
Bring the ancient, time-tested wisdom of traditional Indian cooking into your modern kitchen with our Handcrafted Earthen Mud Pot. Sourced from natural, chemical-free riverbed clay and individually thrown on an artisan's wheel, this pot represents the pinnacle of sustainable, heritage craftsmanship.
Key Features & Benefits:
• 100% Organic & Non-Toxic: Made purely from natural clay with absolutely no lead, chemicals, or artificial glazes. It is entirely safe for your family and the environment.
• Natural Alkaline Balancing: Clay is naturally alkaline. When it interacts with acidic ingredients (like tomatoes, tamarind, or vinegar), it neutralizes the pH balance, making your food gentler on the stomach and naturally sweeter.
• Superior Heat Retention: The porous nature of unfired clay allows heat and moisture to circulate evenly throughout the cooking process. Food cooks slowly and uniformly, locking in natural oils, moisture, and rich, earthy flavors that metal pots destroy.
• Porous Breathing Texture: Micro-pores in the clay regulate evaporation, keeping water naturally cool when used as a dispenser, or trapping steam to keep curries incredibly tender and juicy.
Care Instructions:
Before your first use, season the pot by soaking it in water for 24 hours, then rubbing it with a light coat of cooking oil and heating it slowly with rice water. Hand wash only using warm water and a soft brush—strictly avoid chemical dish soaps, as the porous clay will absorb them.
